prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: cleanup redraw of one existing 2D forehead-fringe rigging layer
Input image: Image 1 already has the correct narrow bangs-only geometry. Preserve its shallow horizontal proportions, strand count, open lower gaps and overall silhouette. Do not reinterpret it as a complete hairstyle.
Primary request: Repaint the exact same single connected forehead-fringe attachment as Image 1 using clean flat cel shapes. Retain the upper overlap strip, the broad diagonal center lock, the smaller pointed locks and the two short end locks. The only intended change is production cleanup: all diffuse illumination around the hair is removed, while the physical hair itself remains fully painted and crisp.
Rendering specification: unlit 2D rigging source with silver-white base, pale-lavender interior shadow, restrained pale highlight and one thin cool-gray contour. Interior color transitions may be hard cel shapes. The external contour uses only normal one-pixel antialiasing. Every pixel beyond that physical edge is absent; do not surround the object with any tonal transition.
Composition/framing: exactly one shallow connected fringe attachment, centered on a wide canvas, uncropped, with large unused margins. Keep it no taller than half its width.
Constraints: no complete wig, crown dome, rear hair, nape hair, bob shell, long side hair, ahoge, face, skin, eyes, glasses, eyebrows, ears, neck, body, clothing, hand, butterfly, ribbon, bow, hairpin, second piece, duplicate view, aura, outer glow, bloom, rim light, backlight, luminous outline, diffuse fringe, feathering, haze, fog, smoke, particles, cast shadow, drop shadow, floor, scenery, text, letters, numbers, logo, signature or watermark. No sprite sheet, atlas page, turnaround, panel grid, inset image or multiple views.
